story.iWant: Toubkal Browser to enable fingerprinting protection and tracker blocking by default
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Implement fingerprinting protection defaults (AC: 1, 7, 8) - [ ] Integrate Canvas API randomization (C++) - [ ] Implement WebRTC IP leak prevention (C++) - [ ] Add User-Agent normalization (C++) - [ ] Enable fingerprinting protection in Brave Shields by default - [ ] Test activation time <2 seconds
- [ ] Task 2: Implement tracker blocking defaults (AC: 2, 6) - [ ] Integrate with existing adblock-rust engine (Phase 0.5.7-0.5.10) - [ ] Enable EasyList and uBlock Origin filters by default - [ ] Configure CNAME uncloaking (aggressive mode) - [ ] Add audit logging for all blocked requests - [ ] Test blocking effectiveness vs. baseline
- [ ] Task 3: Create privacy settings UI (AC: 3, 4) - [ ] Design privacy dashboard component (React) - [ ] Show "Protection: Enabled" status on first launch - [ ] Implement opt-out functionality with privacy warnings - [ ] Add visual indicators for protection state - [ ] Integrate with existing settings architecture
- [ ] Task 4: Implement audit logging for privacy changes (AC: 5) - [ ] Create audit log entries for privacy setting changes - [ ] Integrate with existing audit trail system (Phase 0.5.1) - [ ] Add Ed25519 signature for privacy decisions - [ ] Test signature verification and logging
- [ ] Task 5: Create comprehensive test suite (AC: 9, 10, 11, 12) - [ ] Unit tests for fingerprinting protection (C++ Google Test) - [ ] Integration tests for tracker blocking (TypeScript) - [ ] E2E tests for privacy UI functionality (Playwright) - [ ] Performance tests for activation time (<2 seconds) - [ ] Panopticlick fingerprinting test integration - [ ] Mock external dependencies (adblock-rust, audit logger) - [ ] Achieve ≥80% test coverage - [ ] Use Result pattern for error handling - [ ] No `any` types in TypeScript code

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Fingerprinting protection enabled by default (Canvas randomization, WebRTC IP leak prevention, User-Agent normalization) 2. Tracker blocking enabled by default (EasyList + uBlock Origin filters via adblock-rust integration) 3. Privacy settings UI shows "Protection: Enabled" on first launch 4. User can opt-out via settings (with clear warning about reduced privacy) 5. Audit log entry created when privacy settings changed (Ed25519-signed) 6. Integration with existing ad blocking system (Phase 0.5.7-0.5.10) 7. First-run experience completes in <10 seconds 8. Privacy protection activation time <2 seconds 9. Passes Panopticlick fingerprinting tests (>12 bits entropy reduction) 10. Test coverage ≥80% for privacy settings components 11. TypeScript strict mode compliance (no `any` types) 12. Error handling uses Result pattern 13. Code review approved

constraint.description: Privacy-first defaults with opt-out design - protection must be enabled by default
constraint.rationale: Zero-telemetry-by-default policy requires active user opt-out rather than opt-in

constraint.description: Cryptographic audit logging with Ed25519 signatures for all privacy decisions
constraint.rationale: Privacy claims must be mathematically verifiable through cryptographic audit trails

constraint.description: Browser-level enforcement via Chromium network stack integration
constraint.rationale: Client-side only solutions can be bypassed; real protection requires browser-level implementation

constraint.description: React-based settings UI with Tailwind CSS styling
constraint.rationale: Consistent with established UI framework and design system

constraint.description: Integration with existing ad blocking system from Phase 0.5.7-0.5.10
constraint.rationale: Builds upon established adblock-rust integration rather than duplicating functionality

constraint.description: TypeScript strict mode compliance with no 'any' types
constraint.rationale: Code quality and maintainability requirements from CODING-RULES.md

constraint.description: Error handling using Result<T> pattern throughout
constraint.rationale: Consistent error handling approach defined in coding rules

constraint.description: Performance requirements: <2s activation time, <10s first-run experience
constraint.rationale: User experience requirements to ensure protection doesn't impact usability
